Hillsdale College's popular online course, **" The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives,"** is now FREE on DVD.

In this six-lecture course, you'll explore some of the major themes of Genesis, including the complex relationship between God and man, and what it reveals about divine and human nature.

"The Genesis Story" is taught by Hillsdale College professor of English Justin Jackson, who has taught the subject to undergraduate students here at the College for 15 years. This course aims to deepen a student's theological understanding of the Old Testament by revealing the literary beauty and complexity of the text.

The course begins with a lecture and introduction by the president of Hillsdale College, Larry P. Arnn, in which he explains why we teach the Book of Genesis at Hillsdale College and why it's important to both faith and higher education.

Then, Dr. Jackson explains the four relationships that dominate the Book of Genesis: God and creation, God and man, man and man, and man and creation.

You'll explore these relationships in the narratives of Adam and Eve, Abraham and Sarah, Abraham and Isaac, Jacob and Esau, and finally, Joseph.

This course on DVD is perfect for viewing in your home with your family or for use in small groups such as Bible studies and book clubs.

name: Pete Maysmith, LCV
subject: Celebrating our wins — together
body:
To view this mail in a browser, copy https://links.messages.lcv.org/servlet/MailView?ms=MTQwODI3NDIS1&r=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&j=MjU4MDAzOTUzNQS2&mt=1&rt=0 into your browser.
Peter, It’s been an incredible week — and we couldn’t have achieved these historic
victories without you. Together with our state affiliates, we helped elect pro-climate majorities in
the U.S. House and Senate, secured new pro-clean energy trifecta governments in
six states (and counting!), and helped elect climate and democracy champions at
every level of government across the country. Thank you. These decisive victories are a resounding rejection of Trump’s dirty energy
policies, which are enriching Big Oil and corporate CEOs at our expense. Voters across the country made it clear that they’re fed up with Trump and MAGA
Republican policies jacking up their energy bills, dirty data centers polluting
their communities, and corporate corruption being allowed to run rampant. We listened to these voters, we strategized, and we got to work. With your support, LCV Victory Fund and affiliated entities launched electoral
programs that harnessed voters’ anger over Trump’s failed energy policies,
provided them with clear solutions, and transformed their desire for change into
action. While some races have yet be called, thanks to supporters like you, we were able
to: Win in 29 races to secure a pro-clean energy, pro-democracy majority in the U.S. House.Protect and pick up seven seats in the U.S. Senate, helping climate champions win in IA, ME, MI, NC, NH, OH, and TX and flipping the chamber.Elect 18 governors, including three who flipped their state’s governor’s mansion from red to blue.Secure six new pro-clean energy, pro-democracy state legislative majorities (so far).Win seats on local and state utility boards, state Supreme Courts, and other offices that have an outsized impact on clean energy and climate policy, including an outright majority on the Georgia Public Service Commission to control energy policy in the state.Defeat every single anti-environment candidate on our Dirty Dozen list https://links.messages.lcv.. And this is just the beginning. LCV is ready to tackle high utility bills by advancing clean, affordable energy;
rein in polluting data centers; and bring a pro-climate, pro-democracy agenda to
state capitols and Washington, D.C. We couldn’t have reached this pivotal moment without you, Peter. I’m so
excited for what comes next. With fierce commitment, Pete Maysmith

President
League of Conservation Voters P.S. We can’t wait to work with all the new champions who will be coming to
Congress. Our 2026 New Member Guide https://links.messages.lcv. is up on our website and will continue to be updated. This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. If this isn't the best email address at which to reach you,update your contact information https://www.pages08.net/leagueofconservationvoters/forms/ContactInformation?spMailingID=14082742&spUserID=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&spJobID=MjU4MDAzOTUzNQS2&spReportId=MjU4MDAzOTUzNQS2.Click here to unsubscribe https://www.pages08.net/leagueofconservationvoters/forms/Unsubscribe?spMailingID=14082742&spUserID=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&spJobID=MjU4MDAzOTUzNQS2&spReportId=MjU4MDAzOTUzNQS2 from our supporter list.Send us any comments, criticisms, or feedback here mailto:feedback@lcv.org?subject=, or just reply to this email! Thanks for your support.

Dear Patriot,
My name is James O'Keefe. For twenty years I have sent undercover reporters into places powerful people would rather you never see, and I have published exactly what those cameras recorded. **[That work makes enemies, and a number of them respond by filing lawsuits.](https://links.conservative-usa.com/u/click?_t=c02d37b0057e4505a2324dee8ee3dc76&_m=2697c9d6e7264b69bb4655c559eabb04&_e=Ia9xkHGNy2-QRV9RuHx5HmrMk1RadDUMqePbRlyOPJiv5YxbTtBwAikz2IRAzXop40d73g0eVR6VZZ-BEpp-TnrvNITT9b8cWxLBZdro3TZR1WLws_ucP07dtuJeRMyf_fPgUT0OtyBFvWjBIZd-p-0agXaR--AyyJCAQLERVOJn8zZR5lz7XYmeHjD_imqKen3x-HS8FhY3tZ4lEMuZfxr_Y8STJ_JfHEDSkD7KW65D49bdAxgA7-bInE4HcB2TQOK_0YXz4-FSXWyS3zK0i2Uq35KG4bt112kVzf-HED0g5TFd8NUQKodL9MgDgznJpiZNXq4HqJ5GwwUhmGBophgv6itU_Z6ctg5oqIjDjg3RLFk5_jwgBdO2AboyjmmUMJ8Ppr_6IW5mayvdG9bshC5C1XBbdpioU5INKmHBDAK4yWnKBOSx7El8PYMSStJtiy-3U_PMbvM20HXhESIt9gRHq_CF5Tb1j6Oc3_vW_kEgBFsZhG41PUYWy3pXVJD2zPFJb7erjFtf1bcBndO0nXCi9472YIWvbd0dcTvnoDdIHyI12aqISwxM7toGBOKy6HLnbs7yzZErNYoXPE7cFMRWT2WWmxnXSzZP3y2-vTU4Gf-Vv2gXwlFX3KtMsQ9A3VBPP0vg16Rau54RvYH3Dn55TBAkDfJA1qX8bf0JXxk%3D)** [](https://links.conservative-usa.com/u/click?_t=c02d37b0057e4505a2324dee8ee3dc76&_m=2697c9d6e7264b69bb4655c559eabb04&_e=Ia9xkHGNy2-QRV9RuHx5HmrMk1RadDUMqePbRlyOPJiv5YxbTtBwAikz2IRAzXop40d73g0eVR6VZZ-BEpp-TnrvNITT9b8cWxLBZdro3TZR1WLws_ucP07dtuJeRMyf_fPgUT0OtyBFvWjBIZd-p-0agXaR--AyyJCAQLERVOJn8zZR5lz7XYmeHjD_imqKen3x-HS8FhY3tZ4lEMuZfxr_Y8STJ_JfHEDSkD7KW67r_OU7_u9w0fCAeVT4SN68DOJJl4jXClcwGnU7NyBbjKntMFxqaNPhD1fCrj-DR9YZhd_Gh1dNvA7P0xPIN-ZDiiUhn-8K2VEOIxVopr_aixaguT6HCxVYQH1ynSNwwWX6ovKjnXwlH8zNTa_uGXGE0QUiU35kt_u1BjAMa3STQFu2hGvx__nl3bA2GgLdtk-jeSubUt95ji1vGB5eomzNT4tHMUP0ygRZFbnpOmzj-O2q_vYUv3kpSxbO6DLH9usLgvg8JR1x76gdfvomYZMA21a_j7Zv_8o0fO_0WM9wzr-vwIOf78WeLK7djvX1So4Ocl23y6l1El74_tsEliIaN7MDi8t9-c3REXAOsK8dju6-sAAeb_RknJLuXwNEnJ-szZob6kIMFsPSaK7uamCu96OyKQexqzzN9503ylLhcRCYnBR4wJd1SLZwwW_Oruk%3D)
In 2016 we placed a reporter inside Democracy Partners, a Democratic consulting firm founded by longtime operative Robert Creamer, whose organizations worked with the Democratic National Committee during that election. Here is how it ended. | | Dear Patriot, My name is James O'Keefe. For twenty years I have sent undercover reporters into places powerful people would rather you never see, and I have published exactly what those cameras recorded. In 2016 we placed a reporter inside Democracy Partners, a Democratic consulting firm founded by longtime operative Robert Creamer, whose organizations worked with the Democratic National Committee during that election. She accepted an unpaid role, answered phones, and recorded what people around her said. We published it. They sued me in June 2017, and a jury eventually found against us, entering a $130,000 judgment on the books. We appealed, and then we waited for years while continuing to pay attorneys. On August 21, 2026 , the D.C. Circuit Court of Appeals ruled in our favor two to one , and the entire judgment was erased. Here is why that decision matters far beyond me. The verdict had rested on the idea that our undercover reporter owed a fiduciary duty to the organization she was investigating. Read that again, because it would mean a journalist who takes an internship to document wrongdoing is legally required to protect the interests of the people committing it. That theory would effectively end undercover reporting in this country. The appeals court threw it out, holding that she was never a fiduciary because she performed clerical tasks and had no power to act for the firm. With the fiduciary theory gone, the wiretapping claims fell with it. The judges also held that a plaintiff cannot collect damages when protected speech, rather than unlawful conduct, caused the harm, and they found that the "vast share " of our published material had been lawfully obtained. Nine years of my life, and the result is federal appellate case law that protects the next reporter who does what we did. I want you to understand the game being played here, because winning was never really the objective. People who cannot beat our reporting take us to court to drain us instead. The fund is nearly empty after this appeal, and other cases are still open. If you believe a reporter with a camera should be able to walk into a room and show you the truth, then I am asking you to send whatever you can today. | | **You’re Invited: Bring the Kids! The Ice Age Comes Alive in Redwood City Saturday ** Join me this Saturday, November 7, for the plaque dedication and grand opening of the new HERO Natural History Gallery at the San Mateo County History Museum in Redwood City!

Bring your children and grandchildren to explore the Peninsula as it existed millions of years ago, discover the Ice Age animals that once roamed our region, see a reconstruction of a 15-million-year-old marine mammal and get up close to real mammoth and mastodon teeth! I'm especially proud to have championed a $500,000 Measure K grant to help make this exciting new gallery possible. I'll be joining museum officials and community members for the official unveiling at **1:30 p.m.** The free **History in Motion **celebration will also feature the opening of the spectacular Taube Family Carriage House and Automobile Gallery and Lora Mundi, the beautifully restored 1863 Lathrop-Connor-Mansfield House. **EVENT DETAILS** **When:** Saturday, November 7, 2026
**Time:** 1:30 p.m. – HERO Natural History Gallery unveiling
**Where:** San Mateo County History Museum
2200 Broadway, Second Floor Redwood City. I hope you'll bring the family and join us for this wonderful celebration! For more information, visit [https://historysmc.org](https://us.list-manage.com/1CRP9x3h0Dh?e=c0babbc643&c2id=bfcaacdd1ef4033edfed3d4b1d472a02). Supervisor David J. Canepa
San Mateo County Board of Supervisors * * *

name: Tom Fitton
subject: Judicial Watch Investigates Jack Smith Team’s Security Violations
body:
Covid-19 Origins Update!
| | | ****
---
---
|
---
| **Judicial Watch Sues Over Jack Smith Team’s Security Incidents ****[](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86432&L=39136&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cueW91dHViZS5jb20vd2F0Y2g/dj0xZmlJOGNIa3Z0OCZ1dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=&H=e0f9421920fe3a13c12b643740c17c0f7ed1cc515a9530ec85e23bb99ecc7c79)**
Did the Biden Justice Department hold Special Counsel Jack Smith’s team to the same security standards it applied to President Trump? We’re suing for records exposing how classified materials were handled, alleged security breaches, and potential violations involving Smith and his investigative team. We filed a Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) [lawsuit](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86432&L=39137&F=H&&H=cf99f841d560c9b20dae8c5d63d14ffa9e5ebe3ddb93855e7420ed014b804c0d) against the U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ) for records of security incidents, classified-material handling, and potential security violations involving Smith and members of his investigative team ([_Judicial Watch Inc. v. U.S. Department of Justice_](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86432&L=39137&F=H&&H=cf99f841d560c9b20dae8c5d63d14ffa9e5ebe3ddb93855e7420ed014b804c0d) (Case 1:26-cv-03923)).We sued after the Office of Information Policy failed to respond to our July 10, 2026, FOIA request for communications between senior Justice Department officials and Smith’s office concerning alleged classified-information security incidents, including Sensitive Compartmented Information Facility (SCIF) access, security violations, classified-material handling, security assessments, and any related investigations or disciplinary actions.The request specifically identifies six members of Smith’s team: Carli Rodriguez-Feo, Julie Edelstein, William O’Neil, Stephanie Van Buskirk, Molly Gaston, and Thomas Windom.On July 8, 2026, Sen. Chuck Grassley (R-IA), chairman of the Senate Judiciary Committee, sent [a letter](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86432&L=39138&F=H&&H=95d05c437244cf54d1556ed45ac01993ecddbb823696c8f4851c306e12f6494c) to then-Acting Attorney General Todd Blanche about text messages among personnel in Smith’s office that raised concerns about multiple potential security failures involving classified materials during the time the Biden Justice Department was prosecuting President Trump for [allegedly mishandling](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86432&L=39139&F=H&&H=3eee9cd1810c5afc0d73f3875ef6e814f6ff72877caf1c8f0d7863c30f3f0d5e) classified documents.Messages from July 2023 indicate that investigators may have provided individuals access to [classified materials](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86432&L=39140&F=H&&H=1f0a036c73e5b981583fad1c384297a37f10a825a6a210ba49269f25458ccaa3) without first confirming they had the required “need to know.” Other communications from October 2023 concerned a classified letter that had been left out. In an April 2024 exchange, personnel discussed a SCIF accessible to Smith’s team that had been left open overnight, resulting in what one Justice Department employee described as a security “violation and incident.”In 2023, Smith brought two federal prosecutions against then-former President Donald Trump: one over his alleged handling of classified documents and another over his challenge to the 2020 election results. Both cases were dismissed before Trump returned to the White House in January 2025.Jack Smith’s prosecution team appears to have had serious security failures involving classified evidence. The Justice Department must answer whether it applied the same standards to its own personnel that it sought to impose on President Trump.Before his appointment to investigate and prosecute Trump, Smith previously was at the center of several other controversial issues, the [IRS scandal](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86432&L=39141&F=H&&H=4cefcc81ad1e76a913e8b6bee143807344a05244a66c7dde326b8e36a2bd6b63) among them.We are a national leader in exposing the lawfare and abuse targeting Trump and other American citizens.In June 2026, we [sued](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86432&L=39142&F=H&&H=ff134cac7eb7e197ed68520a4d81d434d2a622c9ed88d7fdd1877d674d5609d7) the Justice Department for records concerning meetings between Smith and members of his team and two Obama-appointed federal judges who presided over matters involving Trump.In May 2026, we obtained records that revealed the FBI’s concerns about the legal basis for the 2022 raid of Trump’s Mar-a-Lago home. The records exposed explicit objections from field agents who warned the Justice Department that the unprecedented raid on Trump’s home lacked probable cause.In April 2026, we sued the Justice Department for records on the Biden FBI’s search warrants used in the April 2021 raid on former New York City Mayor Rudy Giuliani’s residence and office ([_Judicial Watch Inc. v. U.S. Department of Justice_](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86432&L=39160&F=H&&H=37033a637116d5e18d1ccc8157f1aabb768cf52dd71d5d3c5cede8c608176f40) _ _(No. 1:26-cv-01158)). Giuliani served as a personal attorney and informal adviser to President Donald Trump.In March 2026, the Justice Department [reported](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86432&L=39144&F=H&&H=d8fa5dfd3063d1be6761ae42273a64e82813e177fa706b3fda91bbe445ab6dd2) that the FBI found about 1.9 million pages of records that are responsive to our FOIA lawsuit. These documents were reportedly stored in a “hidden room” at FBI headquarters and were first revealed by former Deputy Director Dan Bongino ([_Judicial Watch v U.S. Department of Justice_](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86432&L=39145&F=H&&H=565c661a218a238095a7f05b2b86e7f119b5f66a1224c2a5df913693109259ec) (No. 1:25-cv-04047)).In March 2026, we [sued](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86432&L=39146&F=H&&H=74aa07bc9a996f1e1cf8babe58a9d02cc5be117655c8bd211e2b80cadcac0b08) the Justice Department for records from the FBI’s Biden-era “Arctic Frost” probe, specifically involving the Criminal Division, the Office of Information Policy, Attorney General Merrick Garland, Deputy Attorney General Lisa Monaco and Special Counsel Jack Smith’s team ([_Judicial Watch, Inc. v. U.S. Department of Justice_](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86432&L=39147&F=H&&H=88fce2c9950f31ee92fd5159e4e2ae6fd54405c891411f76bc6c9053a7eb5163) (No. 1:26-cv-00746)).In March 2026, we asked a Georgia state court [to reject](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86432&L=39148&F=H&&H=803bbd50a8c5b317812363b8041ac4c055dff763067974be14a2a2a2be196c85) Fulton County District Attorney Fani Willis’ efforts to continue hiding records about her office’s communications with Jack Smith’s office and the January 6 Committee ([_Judicial Watch Inc. v. Fani Willis et al._](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86432&L=39162&F=H&&H=d0a5d05c5ff41b36b07330db90b6773c8512f899ac4df6a632cbe2971ff3e069)_ _(No. 24-CV-002805)).In February 2026, we [secured the release](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86432&L=39150&F=H&&H=5f560866052f35e2474c759f05bb06026ada56897a27e6be63ea4be282370c2d) of rosters identifying the names of top [deputie](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86432&L=39152&F=H&&H=6fe66c242c9a148cf16f21df86d30ce23ee25388823ff56498412c22cea8b071)[**s**](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86432&L=39152&F=H&&H=6fe66c242c9a148cf16f21df86d30ce23ee25388823ff56498412c22cea8b071) who worked for former Smith ([_Judicial Watch Inc. v U.S. Department of Justice_](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86432&L=39153&F=H&&H=5b97cd24a5861377c2cbc920988ad8cf29c98a0af1b222a99840db193d417da6) (No. 1:23-cv-01485)).In January 2026, we [sued](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86432&L=39154&F=H&&H=a4d84fc097855317329eb5f726f0a089bf5fa2f798e4f28ed2b222bd670e0476) the Justice Department for communications of FBI agents regarding the prosecution of former Trump trade advisor Peter Navarro ([_Judicial Watch Inc. v. **Judicial Watch Seeks Details of Search of Rep. Ilhan Omar's DC Home **We continue seeking the details of the October 12, 2026, federal search of Rep. Ilhan Omar’s (D-MN) Washington, DC, home. Our latest move is a reply brief urging the U.S. District Court for the District of Columbia to unseal search warrant records related to the search.The[ ](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86432&L=39093&F=H&&H=e17c350ca2796d41222680ac048ce8a47daf14d06755d2641a9dc16b6c14ee8e)[October 30 filing](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=86432&L=39093&F=H&&H=e17c350ca2796d41222680ac048ce8a47daf14d06755d2641a9dc16b6c14ee8e) argues that the government has failed to justify keeping the entire warrant docket secret. We seek disclosure of the warrant, application, supporting affidavits, inventory of seized property, and related court records, with any continued withholding limited to specifically justified information.We emphasize that Omar has publicly challenged the search and used it to raise campaign money but has not objected in court to releasing the records:
> Yet nothing has been filed on her behalf in any of the three cases now consolidated before this Court. She has not intervened, has not submitted a letter, and has not asked the Court to keep anything sealed.
The brief further states:
> Representative Omar has chosen what to say about the search and has asked the public to fund her account of it. She is entitled to do so. But the public is entitled to the official record against which to measure that account, and the Government’s account as well.

Americans deserve to see the facts about the alleged disturbing allegations about Ilhan Omar.We initially moved to unseal the records on October 15. The Justice Department confirmed that Homeland Security Investigations carried out a court-authorized search in an ongoing criminal investigation. News reports connected the investigation to potential false statements and immigration fraud.Our investigation of allegations concerning Omar dates to July 2019, when we submitted an ethics complaint seeking an investigation into allegations involving perjury, immigration and marriage fraud, tax fraud, and student loan fraud.We previously obtained the release of a heavily redacted affidavit supporting the August 2022 search of President Trump’s Mar-a-Lago home. We’re suing for records exposing how classified materials were handled, alleged security breaches, and potential violations involving Smith and his investigative team. We filed a Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) against the U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ) for records of security incidents, classified-material handling, and potential security violations involving Smith and members of his investigative team ( (Case 1:26-cv-03923)).We sued after the Office of Information Policy failed to respond to our July 10, 2026, FOIA request for communications between senior Justice Department officials and Smith’s office concerning alleged classified-information security incidents, including Sensitive Compartmented Information Facility (SCIF) access, security violations, classified-material handling, security assessments, and any related investigations or disciplinary actions.The request specifically identifies six members of Smith’s team: Carli Rodriguez-Feo, Julie Edelstein, William O’Neil, Stephanie Van Buskirk, Molly Gaston, and Thomas Windom.On July 8, 2026, Sen. Chuck Grassley (R-IA), chairman of the Senate Judiciary Committee, sent to then-Acting Attorney General Todd Blanche about text messages among personnel in Smith’s office that raised concerns about multiple potential security failures involving classified materials during the time the Biden Justice Department was prosecuting President Trump for classified documents.Messages from July 2023 indicate that investigators may have provided individuals access to without first confirming they had the required “need to know.” Other communications from October 2023 concerned a classified letter that had been left out. In an April 2024 exchange, personnel discussed a SCIF accessible to Smith’s team that had been left open overnight, resulting in what one Justice Department employee described as a security “violation and incident.”In 2023, Smith brought two federal prosecutions against then-former President Donald Trump: one over his alleged handling of classified documents and another over his challenge to the 2020 election results. Both cases were dismissed before Trump returned to the White House in January 2025.Jack Smith’s prosecution team appears to have had serious security failures involving classified evidence. The Justice Department must answer whether it applied the same standards to its own personnel that it sought to impose on President Trump.Before his appointment to investigate and prosecute Trump, Smith previously was at the center of several other controversial issues, the among them.We are a national leader in exposing the lawfare and abuse targeting Trump and other American citizens.In June 2026, we the Justice Department for records concerning meetings between Smith and members of his team and two Obama-appointed federal judges who presided over matters involving Trump.In May 2026, we obtained records that revealed the FBI’s concerns about the legal basis for the 2022 raid of Trump’s Mar-a-Lago home. The records exposed explicit objections from field agents who warned the Justice Department that the unprecedented raid on Trump’s home lacked probable cause.In April 2026, we sued the Justice Department for records on the Biden FBI’s search warrants used in the April 2021 raid on former New York City Mayor Rudy Giuliani’s residence and office ( (No. 1:26-cv-01158)). Giuliani served as a personal attorney and informal adviser to President Donald Trump.In March 2026, the Justice Department that the FBI found about 1.9 million pages of records that are responsive to our FOIA lawsuit. These documents were reportedly stored in a “hidden room” at FBI headquarters and were first revealed by former Deputy Director Dan Bongino ( (No. 1:25-cv-04047)).In March 2026, we the Justice Department for records from the FBI’s Biden-era “Arctic Frost” probe, specifically involving the Criminal Division, the Office of Information Policy, Attorney General Merrick Garland, Deputy Attorney General Lisa Monaco and Special Counsel Jack Smith’s team ( (No. 1:26-cv-00746)).In March 2026, we asked a Georgia state court Fulton County District Attorney Fani Willis’ efforts to continue hiding records about her office’s communications with Jack Smith’s office and the January 6 Committee ( (No. 24-CV-002805)).In February 2026, we of rosters identifying the names of top who worked for former Smith ( (No. 1:23-cv-01485)).In January 2026, we the Justice Department for communications of FBI agents regarding the prosecution of former Trump trade advisor Peter Navarro ( January 2025, the Justice Department to provide us with information on communications between Jack Smith and Fani Willis regarding the prosecution of Trump. Ilhan Omar's DC Home We continue seeking the details of the October 12, 2026, federal search of Rep. Ilhan Omar’s (D-MN) Washington, DC, home. Our latest move is a reply brief urging the U.S. District Court for the District of Columbia to unseal search warrant records related to the search.The argues that the government has failed to justify keeping the entire warrant docket secret. We seek disclosure of the warrant, application, supporting affidavits, inventory of seized property, and related court records, with any continued withholding limited to specifically justified information.We emphasize that Omar has publicly challenged the search and used it to raise campaign money but has not objected in court to releasing the records: Yet nothing has been filed on her behalf in any of the three cases now consolidated before this Court. She has not intervened, has not submitted a letter, and has not asked the Court to keep anything sealed. The brief further states: Representative Omar has chosen what to say about the search and has asked the public to fund her account of it. She is entitled to do so. But the public is entitled to the official record against which to measure that account, and the Government’s account as well. Ilhan Omar is using this search to raise campaign cash, yet she hasn’t asked the court to keep the records secret. Why is the government fighting to hide information about her alleged crimes? Americans deserve to see the facts about the alleged disturbing allegations about Ilhan Omar.We initially moved to unseal the records on October 15. Our reply supports that request in proceedings now consolidated as In re Application of Fourteen Press Organizations for Access to Sealed Search Warrant Records (No. 1:26-mc-144-JEB).As detailed in our earlier release, federal agents reportedly seized Omar’s cellphone, notebooks, computers, and passport. The Justice Department confirmed that Homeland Security Investigations carried out a court-authorized search in an ongoing criminal investigation. News reports connected the investigation to potential false statements and immigration fraud.Our investigation of allegations concerning Omar dates to July 2019, when we submitted an ethics complaint seeking an investigation into allegations involving perjury, immigration and marriage fraud, tax fraud, and student loan fraud.We previously obtained the release of a heavily redacted affidavit supporting the August 2022 search of President Trump’s Mar-a-Lago home. **Lea el boletín en español abajo**

**HISTORY MADE:
TOP PAC's get-out-the-vote work helps flip Texas** ** ** It's official: Our state government is no longer under Republican control. Black and Latino Texans showed up and showed out this midterm in HUGE numbers to vote for progressive candidates up and down the ballot -- from James Talarico and Gina Hinojosa, to judicial candidates and county commissioners -- handing MAGA decisive losses statewide. Across the country, voters came out in droves to make clear that they're sick of this cruel joke of an administration, and that we're in desperate need of a course correction. TOP PAC canvassers were out in force this midterm, knocking on 248,767 doors to reach 395,963 voters in Tarrant, Fort Bend, and Harris counties. In all three, new TOP-endorsed county judge candidates -- Alisa Simmons (Tarrant), Dr. Letitia Plummer (Harris), and Dexter McCoy (Fort Bend) -- dominated their races and comfortably won. Every door our canvassers had was a conversation with a neighbor about what is at stake for their family. Every door helped build this wave we saw in Texas and throughout the country. This is TOP doing what we do -- leading boldly and shaping the future of this state. And we're not done. The work continues. Congratulations to our TOP-endorsed candidates who won big Tuesday. body:

#
# **Philly Reads Literacy Summit on November 14th**
_Join us for workshops for K-12 students, parents, adult learners, and educators_ **[REGISTER TODAY](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100172676.172176.16&gen=1&mailing_linkid=18806)**
* * *
Reading is fundamental, but we know students and adults across the country are struggling to read. We are facing a**literacy crisis**. In Philadelphia, Senator Hughes is calling on everyone to come to the table and address this issue. We can make our communities stronger with the power of reading and education. Our call to action starts with the first annual **Philly Reads Literacy Summit.** [**REGISTER TODAY**](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100172676.172176.16&gen=1&mailing_linkid=18806) We're offering a half day of panel discussions, workshops, and children's health services so our entire community can come together to discuss the issues we're seeing, learn about solutions, and walk away with peace of mind that we will improve reading proficiency across the city.
* * *
**Students, parents, adult learners, and educators will each have a workshop track tailored to them.** [**PLAN TO JOIN US ON NOVEMBER 14th**](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100172676.172176.16&gen=1&mailing_linkid=18806) [](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100172676.172176.16&gen=1&mailing_linkid=18806)

We have lots of information available on these pages about community events and issues affecting our district. name: Republican Party of Wisconsin
subject: A MESSAGE FROM NATIONAL COMMITTEEWOMAN PAM TRAVIS
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY THE REPUBLICAN PARTY OF WISCONSIN** NOT AUTHORIZED BY ANY CANDIDATE OR CANDIDATE'S COMMITTEE
body:
[](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail20.com/t/y-l-fkrdykk-didthutlhu-r/) Republicans of Wisconsin,Sitting in the RPW War Room on election night was tough. The disappointment felt overwhelming, and I know you felt it too. That loss is especially hard because I know how much we put into trying to win: every shift, conversation, dollar raised, and hour spent supporting our party and candidates. I'm personally grateful to each of you for all you gave.History has made midterm elections difficult for the party in power. We worked against those headwinds and sought to earn voters' confidence. We recruited and supported great candidates, organized across our communities, raised money, reached voters, and worked to protect the integrity of our elections. That effort mattered. The results may not be what we hoped for, but they don't erase the work or the capacity Wisconsin Republicans built together.We have too much at stake, and Wisconsin is too important to walk away from. As Senator Johnson has said, "This country is way too precious to give up on." I believe that. My dad didn't raise a quitter, and I'm committed to Wisconsin and to the work ahead. I hope you'll stay with me in that work.The principles our party stands for--individual freedom, personal responsibility, opportunity, and a government accountable to the people--are part of a larger American promise. Our Founding Fathers risked their lives and livelihoods to pursue self-government and liberty, hoping to secure those ideals for future generations. We have a responsibility to carry that work forward across the country while building a stronger Republican Party here in Wisconsin. Speaker Mike Johnson has spoken about passing faith and freedom on to the next generation. That work begins close to home: with neighbors talking to neighbors, volunteers organizing, and county parties equipped to reach voters year after year.My goal is to build lasting infrastructure in Wisconsin and make sure county parties have the resources, training, and support to succeed. I believe our county members are the heart of this movement and can help revitalize it.Months ago, I sought to share a strategy and practical plan with RPW leadership to lay that foundation for success. I still believe this work is needed: strengthening county parties, developing new leaders, and equipping volunteers--the backbone of our movement--with the tools to organize in every corner of Wisconsin. I hope we can make it a priority together.The people closest to the work must shape it. You know how to reach me, and I'll keep listening to your ideas, concerns, and recommendations. I'm grateful to be working alongside you as we build a stronger future for our party. With gratitude and resolve, Pam Travis

The Left's so-called principles are utterly incompatible with those that are the bedrock of our constitutional republic. They're incompatible with individual liberty and free will. They're incompatible with the Judeo-Christian belief system under which this nation was founded. At a time when the very values that make America great are under attack, we must continue to stand strong. We must make sure our fellow citizens understand the seriousness of this situation. I'll never stop defending America, our Constitution, our free market economy, and our Judeo-Christian traditions. And I'll never stop calling out the leftists who want to tear our country down. I know you won't either! I do a lot of things. But one of the most important things I do is work with my colleagues at Landmark Legal Foundation. Landmark Legal Foundation is on a mission. They 're here to protect liberty, property rights, constitutionalism . . . in other words, what you read in the Declaration of Independence and the Constitution. And now, I'd love you to stand with me in supporting this outstanding organization. The Left aren't saviors of democracy.They 're Marxists. And what they're doing is destroying the country. They fight desperately to undermine our election processes and, if elections go against them, they use the courts to obstruct the policies We the People voted for. They persecute their opponents, like when the Biden In justice Department waged relentless lawfare against Trump and his allies. Leftists focus so much energy on the justice system - to control it, to contort it, to use it to promote their insanely radical agenda. Again and again, they turn to rogue left-wing judges to usurp the Constitution and undermine America's founding principles. We must not be silent while these leftists destroy our republic from within. That 's why it's so great to have Landmark Legal Foundation take them on! I love these guys. I've been part of the Landmark family for over three decades . . . as president for 20 years, then Chairman of the Board, and now Chairman Emeritus. These briefs present the strongest possible argument for the constitutional position and help convince judges to do the right thing. In 2024, Landmark made a historic winning argument that special prosecutor Jack Smith lacked the legal authority to target Donald Trump in the classified documents probe. The judge in the case echoed Landmark's arguments in her decision and delivered a huge win over the Left 's lawfare. Landmark also fights to defend free, fair elections. For example, Landmark filed a supportive brief in another key election integrity case. With Bost v. Illinois Board of Elections , they're helping challenge unfair vote-by-mail procedures. Here, Illinois Congressman Mike Bost sued the Illinois Board of Elections over their practice of counting mail-in ballots received after Election Day. Such counting delays results and opens the door for abuse. When the Supreme Court agreed, it marked a major victory for free, fair elections. But this is not the last fight! This isn't political . . . it 's about the Constitution! My Landmark friends are on the frontlines of the battle to preserve our country. They're a vital part of the conservative, constitutionalist force fighting for our country today. | | | | | | Hi, Peter – Roy Cooper here. My friend Scott Colom is running for U.S. Senate in Mississippi, and he needs our support. If you can, [**_I hope you'll split a donation between our grassroots campaigns._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/20269?refcode=email_bu_pros_jtk1987&amount=5&t=2&akid=5343%2E124072%2E_e0ZRK)

---|---
Hey Peter, it’s Scott.
I was born and raised in Mississippi. Growing up here, I never thought I would be locked in what is shaping up to be the closest Senate race in modern history.
[](https://act.roycooper.com/go/20269?refcode=email_bu_pros_jtk1987&amount=5&t=4&akid=5343%2E124072%2E_e0ZRK)
Getting here wasn’t easy.
But over the last fourteen months my campaign has traveled all across the state, speaking with every last voter we could find.
[](https://act.roycooper.com/go/20269?refcode=email_bu_pros_jtk1987&amount=5&t=5&akid=5343%2E124072%2E_e0ZRK)
We even spent some time talking to voters outside Trump’s Mississippi rally last month – _because that’s how you win in a state like this._
[](https://act.roycooper.com/go/20269?refcode=email_bu_pros_jtk1987&amount=5&t=6&akid=5343%2E124072%2E_e0ZRK)
Along the way we’ve been funded by grassroots donations of $5, $10, even $50 at a time. And it means the world to me to know that so many people have my back.
But this race isn’t over yet.
We need to make sure that we stand up for the will of the voters from now until this is fully certified. In a state like Mississippi, we can’t afford to get complacent at the finish line.
Closing this race out is going to cost millions of dollars. This is going to be the most closely divided U.S. Senate race in modern American history.
[**_So please. If you can afford to make a split donation of $5 to Roy Cooper and my campaign’s legal fund to help us stand up for voting rights, I hope you’ll donate today._**

body:
Peter,
Look, when I first jumped into the race to beat Cindy Hyde-Smith, the national pundits didn’t really know what to expect. They wrote us off.
My first campaign event had four people.
Now, we’re on the verge of making history and flipping Mississippi’s Senate race. And it’s all thanks to one thing: GRASSROOTS DONORS.
That’s why, all along the walls of my office, I’ve hung photos of people we’ve met on the campaign trail. They remind me to take a little bit of joy in the campaign.
[](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20261107-partner-sc.Qytoy3&amount=5&refcode=em20261107-1323&t=1&akid=1323%2E34582%2EsB4bBw)
**These photos remind me of why I’m in this race. The people of Mississippi are finally getting the attention they deserve and I am proud to be fighting for the people of Mississippi in this moment.**
But our work is far from over.
We need to make sure that we are able to protect the will of the voters. If we want to do it right - and we HAVE to do it right - it’s going to cost millions and millions of dollars.
I will always stand up and fight for Mississippi. Now, I’m asking you to stand with me.
**[If I can count on your support, use this link and split a donation to my campaign’s legal fund and Small Town PAC. The amount is truly not as important as the donation itself. This is looking to be the most closely divided U.S. Senate race in modern history, so anything you can afford to give makes a major difference.](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20261107-partner-sc.Qytoy3&amount=5&refcode=em20261107-1323&t=2&akid=1323%2E34582%2EsB4bBw)**

Thank you for everything you’re doing,
Scott Colom

name: Roger Lau
subject: Thank you for everything you’ve done
body:
Nothing we accomplished this year would have been possible without you [ ](https://ak.democrats.org/go/98055?t=1&akid=10233%2E22930333%2EftRcoO)
---
**Thank you _so much_ , Derek.** This is Roger Lau. I’m writing today because Democrats up and down the ballot won _big_ on Tuesday, and **I wanted to thank you personally for everything you did to make this possible.** _Thank you_ for keeping up to date with the DNC’s work to elect Democrats up and down the ballot this year. _Thank you_ for being a part of the grassroots movement that flipped Congress **blue** _for the rest of Donald Trump’s presidency._ _Thank you_ for helping the DNC register _thousands_ of new Democrats to vote in key battlegrounds. _Thank you_ for supporting our legal battles against the Trump administration to protect _every American’s_ right to vote. _Thank you_ for fueling our work to organize everywhere and connect with voters to get every last Democrat to the polls. **_Thank you,_ because _nothing_ we accomplished this year would have been possible without your support.** **On behalf of the team at the DNC and the 10,000+ Democratic candidates we supported across the country this year, THANK YOU. Grassroots supporters like you are truly the backbone of our Party, and we are so grateful for _everything_ you’ve given this year.** So give yourself a moment to celebrate — you have earned it. But let me be clear: Here at DNC headquarters, we’re looking ahead to the fight to put a Democrat in the Oval Office in two years (it’ll be here faster than you think). **And just like this year, I know this team is going to break records and continue winning elections.** [**Derek, the road to the White House in 2028 starts today, and I know that with the help of our top grassroots supporters, we can fight and win again up and down the ballot. Will you chip in $7 today to give us a jump start on the fight for the White House?**](https://ak.democrats.org/go/2234?c0=em-dnc-november-2026-gfr.gb4rMu&refcode=em_20261107_10233_fr&amount=7&t=6&akid=10233%2E22930333%2EftRcoO) _If you 've stored your info with ActBlue, we'll process your contribution instantly._ | | | **[Donate $7](https://ak.democrats.org/go/89866?c0=em-dnc-november-2026-gfr.9s4leO&amount=7&refcode=em_20261107_10233_fr&t=7&akid=10233%2E22930333%2EftRcoO)**

name: Mary Peltola
subject: We’re in this for the long haul
body:
Peter,
I wanted you to get this update from me: **Ballots are still being counted, and right now, it’s still too close to call.**
We are going to do everything we can to make sure every single vote is counted in this race.
But I’ll be honest: That is going to take time – and plenty of resources that we don’t currently have.
As we fight to make sure every ballot is counted, we’re going to remain the top target of the DC establishment.
We put everything we had into winning this race, so I’m counting on your help to fight back against their attacks.
It looks like we’re in this for the long haul, so I need your help to sustain our fight until every vote is counted.
From the very beginning, this campaign has been powered by grassroots donations from people like you. I’m proud of that fact, but it means it’s going to take lots of us to stand up to their pressure in the coming days.
That’s why I have to ask:
**[If you can afford it today, please pitch in anything you can to my and Wes Moore’s campaign at this critical moment. It all adds up to help us keep fighting.](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20261107-1.88bRC-&refcode=em-20261107-1&t=1&akid=2282%2E1086043%2EdHnYg_)**
**[CONTRIBUTE ››](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20261107-1.88bRC-&amount=5&refcode=em-20261107-1&t=20&akid=2282%2E1086043%2EdHnYg_)**
Thank you, and more soon.
Mary

name: Swing Left
subject: Mississippi’s Senate race will come down to just a few votes
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Swing Left, [swingleft
body:
Colom is now leading Republican incumbent Cindy Hyde-Smith by just 1,138 votes. He needs our help to cross the finish line.
#
Hi there,
Since we last updated you on Scott Colom’s ballot curing fund, the Swing Left community has come together to raise over $27,000 for ballot-curing efforts in Mississippi.
And we need to keep that momentum going. Swing Left’s political team is keeping a close eye on the results of this race, and while Colom is now leading Republican incumbent Cindy Hyde-Smith by just under 2,000 votes, the race is still too close to call.
This race could come down to provisional ballots. Before Election Day, Mississippi’s Republican Secretary of State flagged 230,000 voter registrations as “inactive.” Those voters were permitted to cast their ballots, but only with a provisional, or “affidavit,” ballot. Mail-in ballots can arrive and be counted, and provisional ballots can continue to be verified until Tuesday. Counties have until November 13 to certify their election results to the state.
As of late Tuesday night, the Colom campaign estimated there were still between 10,000 and 15,000 ballots to be tallied by hand by county election officials. That’s far more than what Scott needs to win this race, but many of those belong to voters who must “cure” their ballot—meaning identify and correct minor issues—or else their votes won’t count.
Right now, there could be thousands of voters who don’t know yet that their ballots need attention. That’s why Scott’s team is racing to find every one of them, tell them what their next steps are, and help them get it done in time.
**They need our help.** The campaign spent down its funds before Election Day, and this operation needs resources for staff, travel, phones, and supplies now to make sure they get the counts they need before next Tuesday’s deadline for all votes to be counted and submitted.
[**With less than a week to cure ballots, will you make a donation to fund Scott Colom’s ballot-curing team and make sure every Mississippi voter’s ballot is counted?**](https://act.swingleft.org/go/27?c0=count-for-colom-2026.XuaVTK&utm_source=ak&amp%3Butm_medium=em&amp%3Butm_campaign=campaign&amp%3Butm_content=20261107&amp%3Brefcode=refcode&t=1&akid=3416%2E1562180%2EcXurFM)
Electing another Democratic Senator in Mississippi would make our new Senate majority even stronger and build more governing power for the next six years.
Mississippi law has no guidelines for a recount, but candidates can pursue legal action to try to have certain ballots counted or thrown out. That means even after the ballots have been counted, costly legal challenges to the results of those counts are possible, which the campaign will also need funds for.
Thank you for supporting Scott’s campaign. We’ll continue to keep you up to date about this race over the coming days.
— The Swing Left Team

**Since 2017, Swing Left has channeled the energy of grassroots volunteers and donors to elect Democrats, up and down the ballot, focusing on the most competitive races that can swing the national balance of power.** [**If you’d like to help support our work, you can make a donation using this link.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_sl_footer?refcode=em20261107-1&t=2&refcode2=3416_1562180_cXurFM&akid=3416%2E1562180%2EcXurFM)

name: David Hogg
subject: Already thinking about 2028
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY LEADERS WE DESERVE, LEADERSWEDESERVE
body:
We’re already laying the groundwork for the next cycle.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20261107-1&t=1&akid=4237%2E587540%2EuXwMmo)
A quick update, Peter:
Following a recount, our candidate Brad Chambers in Pennsylvania has officially won his race by just 30 votes, flipping a GOP state legislative seat. We’re still waiting on results for Mai Vang in California.
We’ll keep you posted on those races. But even as we celebrate the incredible progressive wins across the country, I have to be honest: **our work isn’t finished.**
Republicans didn’t build their grip on statehouses in one cycle, and they didn’t build their majority in Congress overnight either. They built it by recruiting and investing early, showing up year after year, and never taking a cycle off. **If we want to solidify our governing power into 2028 and beyond, we have to do the same.**
That’s why we’re already laying the groundwork for the next cycle.
Starting with candidate recruitment. We’re digging in to find the next class of bold young leaders for Congress and state legislatures. Organizers, teachers, nurses, and workers who are ready to fight tooth and nail for the communities they come from. **We need to hit the ground running right now to get them trained, funded, staffed up, and ready to win — before Republicans have a chance to regroup.**
The good news is, because of the strength of this people-powered movement, we aren’t starting from scratch.
Every leader you’ve helped us elect this cycle is now a part of something better. They’re shaking up the political landscape, rejecting corporate PAC money, and showing what a new kind of politics looks like. And now, they’re going to set the tone for the next generation of young leaders watching them who finally believe that they can run and win too.
That’s how we build lasting power that lasts cycle after cycle. And we can’t do it without you, Peter.
**[So I’m asking you to stay in the fight with us. Will you pitch in $5 today to help us find, train, and back the next class of bold young leaders?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20261107_1_next.xXJd33&refcode=em20261107-4237&amount=5&t=2&akid=4237%2E587540%2EuXwMmo)**

Thank you,
David Hogg
P.S. Our monthly sustainers are a big part of why we were able to make a historic $1.2 million investment in must-win state legislative races across the country and shatter GOP supermajorities. [**A recurring gift gives us the steady support we need to power our work and keep our candidates in fighting shape all year long. If you can, please start a monthly recurring donation today — even $5 helps us plan ahead for what’s ahead.**](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2774?c0=em_ms_lwd_20261107_1_next.mCXsRI&refcode=em20261107-4237&amount=5&t=22&akid=4237%2E587540%2EuXwMmo)

**Good Morning!** On this day in 1914, country comedian and Grand Ole Opry regular [Archie Campbell](https://email.editor.thetennesseeflyover.com/c/eJykkM1qxCAURp_G7CbojRPNwsVQyG667VL8uUmkRoNKQt--pK_Q5Qcf58D5euu3CTGk9dPsqFpbdMKrRmwNiz6xYTGp7jm1zaQVY91yjPnSQGF8MPagQhvXwomam84rC2wy3HWomJg45ZOg0G3KPmGSzlj6HMyACFQATAOXo-d-lBa6oG4gY1QwRiXQfnHSLOAl9cIvi7WEU_Sh5dK3DRumhLUiLvEnn1h6l_cuqq21o5LhRWAmMGPqr_AdDvTB9LmsBOZ7E5hfxW0B9YfZD4sxagLS5f3-JQJTV5Q_rhBjqKMgnK67CfHP0P6Z51TwGwAA__9oPHsw) was born in Bulls Gap. Best known for his writing and acting talents on the hit television show _Hee Haw,_ Campbell also helped start Knoxville's first country-music television show, _Country Playhouse_ , that premiered in 1952. Tennessee lawmakers felt that one day simply wasn't enough to honor the service and sacrifice of our nation's veterans, so they unanimously passed a resolution to observe November as Veterans Month. Learn more in today's _Top Stories_. Also click [here](https://email.editor.thetennesseeflyover.com/c/eJykkL2OpDAQBp_GZCC7YfgJHFxCNpdeiBq7DZaMPbL7QPP2K0ZaafONu9Sq-v49lyf64OP2Fw_SzG6JdJVAzJSXk5gyxnKkyDvGjULZUwjpWkBCXytVy2FBw_6kpcPK6hXUhJ2pSKth6mQ3DRKqXZupfbRynfqxH82KDytb2Y7SjkBTO1mqvL4fKiUHpeQIsnFmRAd2lHawzq2r6CRZzyk3vBNTjFQKkQvvdFJuTDqqoHfmVxHtHwGzgPm6ribQ5lNsUt4EzD66lA9kn2JtKDJlAfMdK2D-Dq0tvgXMt8x9TCcd64f7CdSWMJQao62tLyb9j1yqrO3r8iH40g-ik9uBPny8-Jejnhq-AgAA___ZVY9L) for The American Legion's comprehensive list of restaurants and retailers offering free meals and deals for veterans and servicemembers across the nation on Veterans Day. Is there a right day to run your errands? ## Giant Glowing Sun Lands in Norfolk
A giant inflatable sun makes its North American debut tonight at Old Dominion University's Helios Public Arts Festival, after rain and lightning in the forecast pushed Friday's events to today, [WAVY reports](https://email.editor.thevirginiaflyover.com/c/eJykkDGupDAQRE9jMiNs_OETONiEbDbdEPXgNtNaY4_sxojbr1jNDX5YKqn0Xv15LA-gQHH7DTtarn6JeJaAzJiXcsRUMceUfQp_01UYc6F45EV3epBKyW5cYGWquBhonPVgEKYGrRon05npe-qblx17NU3uafqnH5wCg0a70avvQcPQfa1rQ_beU6oblVKqV61WBpzyXw5HGMBPwnToiFNu-YWV8kaRwIfrpmvXtDfBvpjfRfS_hJ6Fns_zbE-o110KPd9OQs8hrRDkJ3yshJ6TO-T7eAZaJWQu0mNhqhDknirFTfpMDi6JFSMXyUkW4CM7uISem2zd-6QQqAyjMN22A4X_SPzDN6vV_wIAAP__EeGOQw). The sculpture by British artist Luke Jerram shows the sun at a scale of 1:200 million and is lit from within, so its surface appears to churn with solar storms. The free festival runs 5 to 9 p.m. outside the Barry Art Museum on 43rd Street, with an expanded schedule that includes the performances planned for Friday, so check the [museum's website](https://email.editor.thevirginiaflyover.com/c/eJyk0D1ygzAQQOHTiM4MK2SBChVp6Jw2JbOgxexESB794Pj2GecKucA3b97Xbb4hew73TzzIlnObAz2zp1IozbmGeFIKMW3Rf8dXLpQyh5pm2Ul9Abh0w4xr4ZNmhY2zGypC05CFwahOmdH0zW6NgatEvehxVYgjqmEx12UZ9aql6pEatm8PoBsAAHpoJSh0sF0dDahxM0J15LjE1JadTk53Doybf73r2jUejbd7KY8s-g8hJyGnBVN6YSpHzVSPNrrakqtCTvSz88KFYxBy2slzzEJOTbLu8WTvOetBqO5-IPs_uPzzyWnlbwAAAP__U4h4_Q) for updates. It's the festival's sixth year, and Jerram's _Moon_ and _Mars_ sculptures were shown at the first two, in 2021 and 2022.
## Norfolk Eyes Nonstop Flights to Europe
Norfolk's Economic Development Authority voted Wednesday to allow financial contributions to a regional fund aimed at landing nonstop flights between Hampton Roads and Europe, [WAVY reports](https://email.editor.thevirginiaflyover.com/c/eJykkLGunDAQRb8GOq_wrFlC4SIN3UubEg32eBnFayN7APH30UYr5QNeN6MrXZ1zf3_NX8iR0_MXvsjKEeZEZ40kQmWue8oHlZRLyPFPvqpQqZz2MkMHD6W16oYZnfBBs8HW24CGcGzJ6mE0nRl_jPd2tboP3kBYAILrewQAMP0DHIZlgWUwLdt3n9bdoLXWd30DbdDr0Hsa8IFhbExHniWXm6x0cHlyYgzxetPdXH610a4iW23uPxuYGpjO87ydeFzvsIHp7dTAFLPDqD7Px-r_pcijWsjlF1UVuFRR275EdmrJ_lJbFkrCGOOlVoqbCnvyynMhJypEfq5SlWRFe8kbNTC1xfrt5Bi5PobGdM8XcvxHK98c-rDwNwAA___lS5iB). It's the first public body in the region to take that stance since the Hampton Roads Transatlantic Air Service Coalition formed in February, and supporters called the vote the "critical first domino." Airport officials say domestic carriers route European travel through their hubs, so landing a foreign-flagged airline will take financial incentives. Meanwhile, Norfolk International will launch nonstop United service to San Francisco on March 31, 2027, its [first year-round West Coast](https://email.editor.thevirginiaflyover.com/c/eJykkLGunDAQRb8GOiPb64VHQZGG7qVNiWbxGEbxetB4FvT-Ptooyg-8-kpX55xfn8snUKay_YQnTnqmpeBVM6qiLPVV-EQpLInzb_6qilKpvGTx1vfGOWOHBValE5cAbZwSBISxxckNY7Bh_Bhv7T5ZD_ZuwX_0_nFf0T3W4Ecf46OHMMZgW5ref87ZwTnnbq7zLkB06R5xgB7S2ASLkZSl0x1Pko0KQcpfb7pu5Webp131qM3tR-Pnxs_XdXXXLtyxbI2fH69KBWs1m_Cle-Pn_wK3xs__BA0VRSmgxAWyAZKDRY2y4ZRQTOFSlQ9TUU5a8T1UKCYJlJXqyq1M8bgoZ6r90AS7PYHyXzz9Ztlz8n8CAAD__zWckgM) destination.

Kirk just wrapped up this year's "See You at the Library Day," where we countered the Left and brought conservative values straight to America's children.Kirk is busy spearheading the "Bible Revival" movement that gets Biblical values -- that America was founded upon -- back into schools. And Kirk just finished filming Season 3 of our television show "Iggy and Mr. Kirk" that teaches children how to respond to the deceitful culture with Biblical values and steadfast faith.**I'm writing you with such urgency because Season 3 of "Iggy and Mr. Kirk" is in jeopardy.** **[And if I can't raise $48,523 in the next four weeks, "Iggy and Mr. Kirk" will be delayed -- or even postponed indefinitely.](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckctu2zAQRb-G2tHgQ6LkhRYObAUu6rQwgnRJjMiRw5gPgaLc3y9s1D-Q7cWZGZy5f076BM67eHmDgH0uk86LhhnzkiL4mApOOYWry1cDAbVgQlHOKWs1mOJuqGuobG-NBW4q7Hm7rVnDmWTVZ89HNQIoho1UrRnRQqemseN1M6FVI1Suv-_jnLWcSybUBoWRHagWQTAUrCY1A4-5bDLO6-idgVhguU4pG9yYFCrff5YyL0TuiBiIGBY0a8YNRLSp3AkihjHDDemUMr2kZIkYZmhM00mKpmW0lnyi2-4rfNWCyGEtQS9pzQaJ3J8PH0SoexTQujUQuT-cdsef_0MDYQZ3iUTuHx5MbPXL_lW_DK-_9PnwoR-wPh7fftDfO3p-H56DKRaM5X7hfaDPH1S5t_Nf571bVEtqdgng_MOyfLOYWy_-BQAA__-t-5rK)** The radical Leftists who attack us because we're reaching America's children with God's Truth would love nothing more than to see "Iggy and Mr. Kirk" shut down.They hate that "Iggy and Mr. Kirk" has skyrocketed to the top of Angel Studios' streaming service. They hate that we've created a path around the addictive mind rot they put on TV.It's like Kirk always says... It's not enough to complain about culture raising our children. We must create something better for them. The first 2 seasons of "Iggy and Mr. Kirk" have reached millions of children and counting, but Season 3 is in jeopardy.If "Iggy and Mr. Kirk" isn't funded, there will be no voice on TV countering the Left's dangerous lies.Lies like Drag Queens leading a Pride Parade SingAlong on Blue's Clues...Same-sex weddings on Arthur... And Sesame Street using YOUR tax dollars to normalize same-sex parents and men in dresses.And that's just what's on TV. Like when Mr. Kirk teaches Iggy:

* to be BRAVE by speaking truth in the face of the Left's lies.

YOUR IRA & 401(K) ISN'T ON THE BALLOT

Tomorrow you help pick who goes to (or stays in) Washington. One thing
isn't on your ballot: what your money buys.

Government figures out Thursday show prices rose half a percent in
September alone, and 3.6% over the past year.

When prices climb, the dollars in your savings buy a little less food,
a little less at the pharmacy, a little less of everything you live
on.

[Two grocery bags with prescription bottles on a kitchen table. A
label reading $100 in 2016 points to the left bag, full of bread,
apples, bananas and greens, with three pill bottles in front. A red
label reading Same $100 today: about $72 worth points to the right
bag, which holds much less, with two pill bottles. Caption: Your $100

Even Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh said last week that when Americans look
around,

_"...THEY SEE THE PRICES ARE UP."_
Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh

If you're retired, no boss hands you a raise to catch up. Your savings
just have to stretch further.

You can't vote on prices. But you can decide how your savings are
spread out [https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e322783/UaHR0cHM6Ly9saW5rLmdvbGRjby5jb20vNTVwXS4/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjExMDc/LbmNsckdCQ2x3WQ/gau8Qww/s1i88b00245

That's why savers near or in retirement can diversify part of their
savings into physical gold and silver.

From 1973 to 1979, when prices rose about 9% a year, gold rose about
35% a year. Silver soared too.

[Bar chart of average yearly rise from 1973 to 1979: prices rose
8.8% a year, gold rose 35% a year. Past performance is not a promise
of future results.] [https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e322783/UaHR0cHM6Ly9saW5rLmdvbGRjby5jb20vNTVwXQ/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjExMDc/LbmNsckdCQ2x3WQ/gau8Qww/scta9b0b612

That's history, not a promise. Gold and silver have rough stretches
too, be very wary of anyone who says otherwise.

But through that long stretch of rising prices, gold and silver held

# Saturday, November 7, 2026
---|---
**Good Morning!** On this day in 1835, delegates [meeting at San Felipe de Austin](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2O6yAQhZ8Gd0HMAP4pKG7jLrfd0hqbSYwWxxGM7Ozbr5JX2Pbo6Bx939d1ulLK6XH_TxsHed326cFnzSzCZYqUM9WNvrlWoVKfSZb1TDlPaLC9AFxMN9Ei6eAJmhhmEwdoOEA3OOOxt7ZZg3c440IcvY8A1INpe4h-iLNDZ9k1KbzXAEwHaIxF3XO0zg9D1_LctjYqZzgm2YuWlYVfVG_5Zz-46GXfmhxWkWdV9p_CUeF4nqeWmvWnqO_7oXDk15rmJFXh-Imh8wrHyEumQkvaH3qVLTclxOcbL9W2U87cN0r58yF_VHME_A0AAP__4fF5Rg) declared that Texans had taken up arms against Santa Anna. They stopped short of independence, pledging loyalty to Mexico if its 1824 Constitution were restored. Dallas wants the Stars to stay put. City leaders are already making their pitch to keep the team downtown. Get the details today's _Roundups_. Is there a right day to run your errands? In August 2026 the national debt passed $40 trillion.1 It was not
voted on. There was no ceremony. Most Americans found out from a
headline, if they found out at all.

Somebody has to absorb it

A debt that size does not simply sit there. It gets serviced,
refinanced, and eventually dealt with — and there are only three
ways to deal with it: raise taxes, cut spending, or reduce the real
value of what is owed by letting the currency weaken. The first two
require Congress to do something unpopular on the record. The third
requires nobody to do anything at all.

That is why the figure matters to a retirement account rather than
just to a budget committee. Every dollar in your IRA is a claim
denominated in the same currency the debt is denominated in.
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e2749036/UaHR0cHM6Ly9vZmZlcnMuYmlzaG9wZ29sZGdyb3VwLmNvbS9kZWJ0Lw/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjExMDc/LbmNsWWxxU2p4Qg/qP3V0bV90ZXJtPURlYnQ0MFQmbGVhZF9zb3VyY2U9ZGVidCZwdWJsaXNoZXI9anBtXQ/gau8eyw/s9qa61cf869
If the obligation is managed down in real terms, that happens through
your savings, not around them.

The evidence is already behind us. It takes roughly $1.95 today to
buy what a dollar bought in 2000.2 Nothing was confiscated. The unit
was simply worth less each year, and savers holding it carried the
cost quietly.

Gold is the one asset in this conversation with no issuer. No
treasury can print it, no company can dilute it, no counterparty can
default on it. Central banks themselves have been buying more than a
thousand tons a year.3 They are not doing it for the yield.

You are allowed to hold physical gold inside an IRA. Most savers
have never been told that, because the firms holding their money do
not sell it. The free 2026 Gold IRA Guide walks through exactly how a
rollover from an IRA, 401(k) or TSP works, which metals the IRS
allows, how insured depository storage works, and the mistakes that
cost retirees the most. It is free and it takes about thirty seconds
to request.

subject: I need your thoughts on socialism
body:
A recent poll found that more than half of Generation Z is likely to vote for candidates who hold socialist positions.

This sponsored message from Inside Scoop Politics is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckc1u2zAQhJ-Gukngj36sgw5BZANFnQSFg_Yo0ORKWpTkCiLp1G9fGE1eoNfdDzOYmV8v04tGh2F51R4GjHGyZCcMAPZOeU8r5WVNkUIkg9pNksu2FKLk3aRNwhtMtS7s0EhxmA8FDKLra960TaOKdajN3NamvwreXaXtZSM1n6WV1kopri0UODz0hOCdUFzKvjocTD8bY2bVqr5XPat53qxOUGGIaCEaom0jhwlNrGhfCjesKW2RqScmT0yeMMxUrehctNpBBTYzefpYdSotlXfKZVox_C71lXIq_4XC6MuY9xvcmTpFWDyE9EwWmBq5aJv-lctann--jW_j8fjMZJuTnyLl3TyQbae4gUkYls-XB4vZMzWC1-g-j0b7TeMSmBq93v9g9JOhcIM96oQUvigKCUJiajwf3y_vT-fv04-u_Ha5lF9FFftgtw90DmPbsZovD4_KkC_S_853G-TfAAAA__9oR64y)

| | Let’s talk about socialism**.** A recent poll found that more than half of Generation Z is likely to vote for candidates who hold socialist positions. And we’re seeing the consequences at the ballot box. Last year, voters in America’s largest city elected a self-described socialist as mayor. And he is far from alone. **Socialist ideas once considered unthinkable in America are gaining ground—especially among younger Americans.** That makes it more important than ever to understand what socialism promises, what history teaches about its consequences, and what its rise could mean for liberty in America. That’s why I’d like to invite you to take part in a short conversation about socialism. **Click the secure link below to share your thoughts and explore these important questions with Hillsdale College:** **[https://info.hillsdale.edu/what-do-you-think-about-socialism-survey](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckc1u2zAQhJ-Gukngj36sgw5BZANFnQSFg_Yo0ORKWpTkCiLp1G9fGE1eoNfdDzOYmV8v04tGh2F51R4GjHGyZCcMAPZOeU8r5WVNkUIkg9pNksu2FKLk3aRNwhtMtS7s0EhxmA8FDKLra960TaOKdajN3NamvwreXaXtZSM1n6WV1kopri0UODz0hOCdUFzKvjocTD8bY2bVqr5XPat53qxOUGGIaCEaom0jhwlNrGhfCjesKW2RqScmT0yeMMxUrehctNpBBTYzefpYdSotlXfKZVox_C71lXIq_4XC6MuY9xvcmTpFWDyE9EwWmBq5aJv-lctann--jW_j8fjMZJuTnyLl3TyQbae4gUkYls-XB4vZMzWC1-g-j0b7TeMSmBq93v9g9JOhcIM96oQUvigKCUJiajwf3y_vT-fv04-u_Ha5lF9FFftgtw90DmPbsZovD4_KkC_S_853G-TfAAAA__9oR64y)** Your responses help us connect you with Hillsdale educational content on these important questions—the same kind of teaching we make available to millions of Americans nationwide. And the need for that teaching is urgent. **Too many young Americans have never learned what socialism really means—or the dismal record of its failures wherever it has been tried.** Too many are not being taught about America’s heritage of liberty or why the Constitution is essential to preserving freedom. For decades, progressive ideas have gained influence throughout American higher education. The result is a generation increasingly **receptive** to socialism and increasingly **unfamiliar** with or even hostile to the principles of liberty. **That’s why our educational outreach is so important.** Through free online courses and other educational efforts, Hillsdale is reaching beyond its campus to teach millions of Americans about socialism, the Constitution, and the principles necessary for a free society to endure. **Now is the time to consider the rise of socialism in America.** Please click below to share your thoughts, explore these important questions, and discover how you can join Hillsdale College in confronting socialism on the battlefield of education. **[https://info.hillsdale.edu/what-do-you-think-about-socialism-survey](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckc1u2zAQhJ-Gukngj36sgw5BZANFnQSFg_Yo0ORKWpTkCiLp1G9fGE1eoNfdDzOYmV8v04tGh2F51R4GjHGyZCcMAPZOeU8r5WVNkUIkg9pNksu2FKLk3aRNwhtMtS7s0EhxmA8FDKLra960TaOKdajN3NamvwreXaXtZSM1n6WV1kopri0UODz0hOCdUFzKvjocTD8bY2bVqr5XPat53qxOUGGIaCEaom0jhwlNrGhfCjesKW2RqScmT0yeMMxUrehctNpBBTYzefpYdSotlXfKZVox_C71lXIq_4XC6MuY9xvcmTpFWDyE9EwWmBq5aJv-lctann--jW_j8fjMZJuTnyLl3TyQbae4gUkYls-XB4vZMzWC1-g-j0b7TeMSmBq93v9g9JOhcIM96oQUvigKCUJiajwf3y_vT-fv04-u_Ha5lF9FFftgtw90DmPbsZovD4_KkC_S_853G-TfAAAA__9oR64y)** Socialism may be gaining ground—but **it is never too late to preserve and defend liberty through education.** I hope you’ll join the conversation. Warm regards,Bill Gray, ’01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale College P.S. Your thoughts on the rise of socialism really matter. Send them our way using this secure link: **[https://info.hillsdale.edu/what-do-you-think-about-socialism-survey](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckc1u2zAQhJ-Gukngj36sgw5BZANFnQSFg_Yo0ORKWpTkCiLp1G9fGE1eoNfdDzOYmV8v04tGh2F51R4GjHGyZCcMAPZOeU8r5WVNkUIkg9pNksu2FKLk3aRNwhtMtS7s0EhxmA8FDKLra960TaOKdajN3NamvwreXaXtZSM1n6WV1kopri0UODz0hOCdUFzKvjocTD8bY2bVqr5XPat53qxOUGGIaCEaom0jhwlNrGhfCjesKW2RqScmT0yeMMxUrehctNpBBTYzefpYdSotlXfKZVox_C71lXIq_4XC6MuY9xvcmTpFWDyE9EwWmBq5aJv-lctann--jW_j8fjMZJuTnyLl3TyQbae4gUkYls-XB4vZMzWC1-g-j0b7TeMSmBq93v9g9JOhcIM96oQUvigKCUJiajwf3y_vT-fv04-u_Ha5lF9FFftgtw90DmPbsZovD4_KkC_S_853G-TfAAAA__9oR64y)** Thank you in advance for your response!

The University of Arizona team is continuing this work through a national randomized clinical trial following veterans with PTSD over 15 months. Lead researcher Maggie O'Haire asks whether dogs can help them ["overcome the stresses and challenges"](https://email.editor.thearizonaflyover.com/c/eJyk0D2O3SAUxfHV2B0WXzZxQZHmdZM2pXWBa4OEwYIbWzOrj16UHcwGjs7v__tj-4CUUzl-wYmW4GvfCj49IxG2rWO7k8dQj96wIzQfc-qEZZNcLkwIxs0GntKNm4YxWLX41egRrTCr5vNilB6j5T4YZ1al5a6ccm5xQofVKb2C03PAMdn3nhDcCMVnJaf9hzROOe9mMwcUatAcQ6LaJooILX3VAnv-rDe2yddzzDYSXX1QPwf5GuTreZ7p6p9X7TTVdgzy9Z_C3hYG14XQGFWGJULxyE4sBJlFhEyRQQmsV58gs_1P8ZRqSeVge23sRsIGpbMnUWQX9TDI19hsuJ6Uc-qLGTQ_Tkj53zH6btPbyr8BAAD__5rDkJ4) involved. A [2024 study of 156 veterans](https://email.editor.thearizonaflyover.com/c/eJyk0DtuhDAQANDTmG4tj79L4SKKRLdRupTImAFGMgbZFqvs6aPkCrnAK97XY3wESpTXj7Cjb-G1jBmfNWFrWMaK5aKI87HWghVDiVui2jCPUkh7A7gJN4bY6MJRh272ysbe6Q49uF4LY53S3ebv1hkVnESrZ6elkdj32i5GGAF6MrYj_-sBCAdKGCX5cpduUlOcjDMzgmJa4EztKLxtGAq9jhyW9H1cWHg89i75rbWzMvXG5MDkcO6R5zgRz2nnmTa-HheTQyiNYsLK5PD5eAcAA6CByaErfj6flBJV65gW6x4o_cntvymXlz8BAAD__861dE0) found that those with trained service dogs scored nearly 12 points lower on a PTSD symptom checklist after three months than those still waiting. It wasn't randomized, so it can't prove causation; a randomized trial is now underway. Air Force veteran Kory Kelly, a study participant, said of his service dog, _" Merin hasn't erased my challenges, but she has helped me face them."_

Hey everyone, Matt here.
AI data centers, legislation, regulation, intellectual property, jobs, music, and art have all moved into the conversation relatively quickly, before many people in the United States, or around the globe, actually understand what AI is.

They know the Terminator version. They might not know what they can download on their phones or how to use it. Yet AI has permeated our lexicon, our political dialogue, and our everyday conversations to the point where there is no escaping it.
Those conversations are for another time. Today, I want to focus on the economics.
We can argue about ethics, morals, principles, which jobs to protect, how children should learn, or what artificial sentience means. We can debate the Turing test and the meaning of life. But we have a pressing economic problem sitting in front of us.
If this isn't an AI bubble, then we're absolutely lucky.
**If it is, we could be looking at one of the biggest economic bubbles in history.**
Let's lay out the numbers...

_**Cliff 's Note:**_
##### Democrats flipped 34 House seats that Trump carried in 2024 (so far). Matt Robison called the wave back in April, and in today's Midterm HQ he shows where it came from.
##### Behind the paywall: the answer to what every Dem should be asking: Did fed-up Republicans stay home, or did some vote for us? His numbers have the answer, and it determines what we do next.
##### [Upgrade for the full story and more, like access to the full interviews from our Election Day 12-hour live](https://substack.com/redirect/a110071d-138f-45b4-b956-c4e04ed8f0c2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) [and the ](https://substack.com/redirect/a110071d-138f-45b4-b956-c4e04ed8f0c2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[Insider](https://substack.com/redirect/a110071d-138f-45b4-b956-c4e04ed8f0c2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[ section with what I'm hearing behind the scenes](https://substack.com/redirect/a110071d-138f-45b4-b956-c4e04ed8f0c2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

_**-- Cliff**_
* * *
**The Topline: a stunning result we saw coming, but not quite THIS**
I want to start with a confession: the 2000 election was my fault.
Back then, I was the chair of the Harvard Kennedy School Democrats. On election night, I organized a watch party, and when Florida was called for Al Gore, I did the natural thing: I snuck out for a champagne run. Walking back in the room with a crate in my arms 45 minutes later, the looks on 80 or so Democrats' faces wiped the smile off my own. Florida had, of course, been taken back out of the win column, and soon after, it was shaded red on our TV screens. The rest was history.
Now, do I _really_ think I personally jinxed the entire election? Mmmm...no. Not really. If you've read _Midterm HQ_ here or on my Substack _Worth Knowing,_ you know just how obsessively I rely on evidence, facts, and just plain math. But still, in the rest of my active career in politics--including 10 years as a senior congressional staffer and multiple runs atop congressional campaigns--I never lost that inner kernel of suspicion that maybe, just maybe, it was a good idea to keep an eye on karma.
Throughout this year, I stuck with the evidence. As far back as April, when Cook Political Report was saying the Republicans were ahead, I was saying that Democrats were the "solid favorites." Last week, I reiterated what a huge result I thought Democrats were about to have. The numbers showed a bell curve of outcomes--with the likeliest being a bunch of legislative chamber flips, a majority of governors, 235 seats in the House, and 51 or 52 in the Senate--but with a small polling error having a big impact on the Senate. So I predicted that result.
But was there still that tiny voice echoing from 26 years ago saying maybe I shouldn't mess with cosmic forces? Probably. Which is why I felt compelled to also prepare everybody for the high likelihood that this election wouldn't really be over on November 4.
The end result is that I feel mostly vindicated (kudos to Cliff Schecter and Dave Schuster, who took the most bullish line on the Senate number). And I've never been happier to be wrong in my prediction that we were in for a dark and difficult November like we had in 2020.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a110071d-138f-45b4-b956-c4e04ed8f0c2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
At the end of the day, it was a glorious outcome. Not because of the partisan victory, but because of what it says about America. A friend of mine--a _Republican_ who has been disgusted with Donald Trump but doesn't love Democrats--texted me on Wednesday to say how proud this election made them feel to be an American. To see democracy turn everything upside down without a shot fired. This is still an incredible thing about the U.S. Other countries have copied it. We invented it. And we should never stop being proud of it and amazed by it, in the same way I felt proud and amazed every single day that I went to work in congress and looked at the Capitol dome.
**But what about the Spider-Man question?**

His numbers have the answer, and it determines what we do next. . -- Cliff The Topline: a stunning result we saw coming, but not quite THIS I want to start with a confession: the 2000 election was my fault. Back then, I was the chair of the Harvard Kennedy School Democrats. On election night, I organized a watch party, and when Florida was called for Al Gore, I did the natural thing: I snuck out for a champagne run. Walking back in the room with a crate in my arms 45 minutes later, the looks on 80 or so Democrats' faces wiped the smile off my own. Florida had, of course, been taken back out of the win column, and soon after, it was shaded red on our TV screens. The rest was history. Now, do I really think I personally jinxed the entire election? Mmmm...no. Not really. If you've read Midterm HQ here or on my Substack Worth Knowing, you know just how obsessively I rely on evidence, facts, and just plain math. But still, in the rest of my active career in politics--including 10 years as a senior congressional staffer and multiple runs atop congressional campaigns--I never lost that inner kernel of suspicion that maybe, just maybe, it was a good idea to keep an eye on karma. Throughout this year, I stuck with the evidence. As far back as April, when Cook Political Report was saying the Republicans were ahead, I was saying that Democrats were the "solid favorites." Last week, I reiterated what a huge result I thought Democrats were about to have. The numbers showed a bell curve of outcomes--with the likeliest being a bunch of legislative chamber flips, a majority of governors, 235 seats in the House, and 51 or 52 in the Senate--but with a small polling error having a big impact on the Senate. So I predicted that result. But was there still that tiny voice echoing from 26 years ago saying maybe I shouldn't mess with cosmic forces? Probably. Which is why I felt compelled to also prepare everybody for the high likelihood that this election wouldn't really be over on November 4. The end result is that I feel mostly vindicated (kudos to Cliff Schecter and Dave Schuster, who took the most bullish line on the Senate number). And I've never been happier to be wrong in my prediction that we were in for a dark and difficult November like we had in 2020. | | ---|---|--- At the end of the day, it was a glorious outcome. Not because of the partisan victory, but because of what it says about America. A friend of mine--a Republican who has been disgusted with Donald Trump but doesn't love Democrats--texted me on Wednesday to say how proud this election made them feel to be an American. To see democracy turn everything upside down without a shot fired. This is still an incredible thing about the U.S. Other countries have copied it. We invented it. And we should never stop being proud of it and amazed by it, in the same way I felt proud and amazed every single day that I went to work in congress and looked at the Capitol dome. But what about the Spider-Man question?** Continue reading this post for free in the Substack app | | | | | | | (C) 2026 Cliff Schecter PO Box 8384, Cincinnati, OH 45208 ? ?
